description: Halal guard (optional, user-selected tier): excludes haram businesses and businesses tied directly to interest. Ranking stays halal-blind; the guard filters after ranking.

strict.note: Strict: haram/interest-based sectors + tobacco excluded, interest-bearing D/E<=0.5, long-term D/E<=0.2

flexible.note: Flexible: haram/interest-based sectors + tobacco excluded, interest-bearing D/E<=0.8

off.note: Off: no halal filter, debt gate 1.0 passthrough

L1.note: sector_map overrides Food_Beverage for BATBC to Tobacco; universal_haram + halal_sensitive merged per tier

dses.note: Not used: the guard is defined by business activity and interest exposure, not by index membership

candidate_universe.note: Guard applied after ranking; view-only filter at S6

purification.note: purification_rate = max(0, debt_equity / gate) * 0.05 capped 0.05; 0 if clean
